windows-macos-linux: Same shared runtime sources compiled and executed by all three host gates. Windows-only test executes real installed native/WoW64 leaves.
tests-docs: New shared/native modules registered in the existing library target; exact native replay is compiled via include_str. Documentation and primary/raw proof are separate from product source.
